## 491. A formation's level as the internal part, along one run (UE28)

Board item UE28 ([design](../../development/ue28-a-formations-level-as-the-internal-part/DESIGN.md)). 03 §1 reads the principle's blanket so: a formation's support and observed levels are its sensory states, and what it folds of them its internal states. UE27 (§488, `Becoming.BlanketCouplings`) made the first half a theorem by construction, with a model fed by what couples in as the agent, and left open a formation's own record as the internal part, in the blanket's record and the principle's page §5. In the World a formation and a condition are roles of one relatum (`Becoming.Roles`), so a formation has a level of its own, which balance moves by what the relata present give to it and take from it, itself among them where it takes part. This section asks, along one run of a World, when that level is itself such a fold of what couples into it and its act, so that it is the internal part with no model beside it. Only the level is asked about; the formation's other records stay outside the internal part.

**Its standing.** One near-definitional result. The reading along one course is consistency part by part read with the step as the external part, and the law given its functions is its functional form; the World's part is that reading's instance with a value across steps and the formation's act, stated on the World's records, balance rearranged pairwise. The condition is the elementary one under which a single trajectory comes from a time-invariant deterministic state machine: equal state and input at two times give equal next state and output, a relation being a function exactly where equal readings have equal successors. New is stating it on the World's exchange, pairwise, with two witnesses showing that whether what moves the level couples in does not decide it: the second half of 03 §1's reading holds of the level exactly where the condition does, failing at a drain in three phases and holding at a drain and feed in two, while the first half holds throughout. It is one more reading in UE27's classification of which blanket a thing has, not a result beside it: its world's side is a reading of the course by the step (UE27's first level, for one course), its agent's side a partition fixed by the formation's records apart from the run (the third level), and with a value or an act carrying the step it would fall wholly into the first level, which is why the World's reading takes a value across steps and the formation's own act. The step still enters as far as the World's own records carry it, through admission at each step and the formation's rows. The witnesses are built to show what they show.

**The reviews.** An independent review of the design (REVIEW-UE28-DESIGN) found fifteen points, four high: the first design's correspondence part was empty, a model's law under another name, so the reading became one course with the step external and its iff, the World's run read through it; that law ran one step behind balance, so the law given its functions moves its internal part by the sensory state at its own step; "exactly where" had one direction only, the act and the world's half missing, so the iff is stated along one run with the act in it and the world's clause across runs left open; and the slogan that a formation drained or fed by what does not couple in is no blanket's interior was false, replaced by determination, with two witnesses. The rest fixed the reading's choices (courses read directly, the act on listed relata with presence, the formation's other records external), named the self-bearing case, made the drain balanced and periodic, stated the exchange form pairwise, read "keeps" as a fold, and counted one result. A review of the scratch Lean (REVIEW-UE28-LEAN) built a probe and found thirteen more, three high: `Web.ValuesThrough` compares values at one step only, so a value carrying the step admitted the phased drain, and the World theorem now takes a value across steps, met by `Web.listed_values`' value, and names no value; the act was any course, with which every run passes, and it is now the formation's rows where it takes part; and the condition is tested only where the states recur, the steady feed passing vacuously, so it was replaced by a drain and feed in two phases whose level recurs. The rest said that the world's side is the run read by the step, put presence in the act, said what self-coupling leaves, proposed the texts this landing writes, renamed at claim time (stepExternal, AgentConsistent, stepLaw, levelParts, TwoRelata), and named the known condition in the standing. Every point was taken (DESIGN §6 and §7), the module rebuilt with 70 theorems in 140 declarations, every axiom report empty. A review of the landing texts and records (REVIEW-UE28-LANDING) found eighteen more, one high: several short texts said that along one run the level is the internal part of a blanketed law, where the Lean gives some law determined part by part, possibly partial, a blanketed law following only from given functions; every such text now says a law determined part by part, and the open items name a blanketed law for the level from consistency alone. The rest restored the statement's step and "what couples in", kept the Pearl–Friston contrast and the proponents' concession in the correspondence, called the state-machine condition elementary rather than citing a literature for it, carried the recurrence caveat to the page, the laws and the short texts, withdrew an unproved "only by the step" for self-bearing formations, took the line between the witnesses out of a law and kept the act in it, put the level, not the formation, in the reading, split and rewrote 03 §1's paragraph without coined terms, stated the act's presence course and `listed_values`' conditions as the Lean has them, said where the step still enters, added the dependency on the record of balance and coupling, and used one name for the value and the step. **Decisions at landing.** No new record and no new module: UE28 extends UE27's module by a last part and amends UE27's record, homed in 03 §1, since it is one more reading in the classification of which blanket a thing has, and the record counts one result, not its theorems. The record's statement is rewritten compactly within its cap to cover the level; UE27's clause that the sensory course is the formation's own course leaves the statement and stays in its first law. The correspondence takes the clause on single runs, which UE27's sentence that a single run constrains nothing under the time-unrolled blanket needed beside the phased drain, and the state-machine remark, shortening author lists and dropping UE27's closing sentences that the join forbids nothing (kept in does_not_show) and that the readings are in the design (kept in the references), the "AI reading" label staying. 03 §1's reading says "folds" for "keeps", which removes the clash with the glossary's keeping, and its open clause narrows to runs taken together, the step off the world's side and the other records. UE27's home sentence that the agent is a model, not the formation's own record, now points to the level's two paragraphs, which follow the three levels rather than the home sentence. The page narrows §5's item and states the level in In brief, the claim table, §1 and §4; its Standing is unchanged, the level's condition being near-definitional and elementary. 08 §8 gains the correspondence clause. The blanket's record narrows its open item and changes nothing it states.

**Readings** [AI reading, D45]. A formation's own level is the internal part of its blanket where its next level and act are fixed by its level, what couples into it and what it does: then the level itself, with no model beside it, folds what couples in, the formation's other records staying outside. Where something that does not couple into it moves it on a period its level does not carry, a model fed by its couplings can still be the agent, but its level is not the internal part; the two halves of 03 §1's reading come apart there. What decides is not whether what moves the level couples in, but whether the level, what couples in and the act fix the next step.
